data.content_ref: inline:exp-hist:{"target": "12f82078ebdfc02d4da60d0ef229e7e5a86a938a053b3037a9d9a1f668b839da", "seq": 1, "objection": "The argument fails because Popper's own formal definition of verisimilitude (truth-content minus falsity-content) was proven by Tichý and Miller in 1974 to be logically incoherent for comparing false theories. Since all scientific theories are strictly false in Popper's framework (having been or being liable to be falsified), they all have infinite falsity content, rendering the comparison of 'degrees of truth-likeness' impossible without reintroducing probabilistic assumptions about the likelihood of future tests yielding specific results. Therefore, the 'rational bet' described is not a non-inductive logical rule but an unjustified inductive leap disguised as a metric that does not formally exist.", "outcome": "raised and not answered; the target's status did not move"}
